Name: FS Become an Axolotl
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
using fashion sense, this mod adds different colored axolotl tails and gills as accessories ♡

≽(◕ ᴗ ◕)≼

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. download and install fashion sense
2. download this mod
3. unzip folder into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ comes with gills and tails in the colors pink, albino, yellow, blue, lavender and black (but you can also use the color changer to change the colors)
♡ also comes with baby axolotls to perch on top of your head as a hat
♡ the outfits in the pictures are from this mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15266 and this mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14350
♡ sprites made by me, although i used the tail (fin-tip) from the animals and mythological creatures stuff mod as a base for the axolotl tails
